hooks.command: mkdir -p ~/.cache/iterate-hack && [ -z "$(find ~/.cache/iterate-hack/traces.stamp -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ] && touch ~/.cache/iterate-hack/traces.stamp && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && nohup uv run --quiet tools/traces.py push >> ~/.cache/iterate-hack/traces.log 2>&1 &

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo 'Open work (tools/board.py):' && uv run --quiet tools/board.py ls work && echo 'Newest board items:' && uv run --quiet tools/board.py ls idea skill knowledge result --new --n 10 && echo 'Team messages (tools/msg.py; times UTC):' && uv run --quiet tools/msg.py read && m=$(git log -1 --format=%cr -- meta/) && echo "Newest team-meta-review entry (meta/): ${m:-none}"
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mkdir -p ~/.cache/iterate-hack && nohup uv run --quiet tools/traces.py push >> ~/.cache/iterate-hack/traces.log 2>&1 &
